title: Turbulence time-step ratio
overview: Scales the per-cell turbulence time step used in the unsteady spectral contribution assembled by UTurbSpectrum::CalcUnsteadySpectrum. This is a turbulence-equation control, not the mean-flow CFL ramp.
principle: The turbulence time-step is multiplied by turb_cfl_ratio before it enters the implicit unsteady term. In dual-time mode the physical-time contribution is added separately.
architecture: TurbCom::Init reads the Real parameter. UTurbSpectrum::CalcUnsteadySpectrum applies it in both single-time-step and dual-time branches. It is separate from cflst/cfled/ncfl and timestepModel.

proves: UTurbSpectrum::CalcUnsteadySpectrum multiplies the turbulence time step by turb_cfl_ratio in both branches.
The dual-time branch adds the physical-time contribution separately.
does_not_prove: A universal default or admissible range.
Measured sensitivity across all turbulence models.

verification.scope: Declaration linkage is not a record of execution or numerical validation.

formulas.title: Turbulence unsteady spectrum scaling
formulas.plain: dt_scaled = dt_turb * turb_cfl_ratio; S = (sp2 / dt_scaled) V

symbols.notes: Default and range are not established.

caveats: The formula documents the audited source branch; it is not a universal model identity or a recommended parameter setting.
